title: Inquest into Hall Beach man's in-custody death begins today
subtitle: Tommy Anguilianuk died in January 2013
article: A coroner's inquest into the death of a man who escaped from a police holding cell begins today in Hall Beach, Nunavut.
Tommy Anguilianuk was taken into RCMP custody on Jan. 20, 2013 but escaped. He died the next day.
Nunavut's chief coroner, Padma Suramala, will preside over the week-long inquest, which is scheduled to run until Friday.
Under the Nunavut Coroners Act, the coroner must call for an inquest when an individual dies in police custody.
It's not the only mandatory inquest taking place in Nunavut this year.
An inquest into the death of Felix Taqqaugaq, who was shot by police in Igloolik in 2012, will be held in that community Nov. 1-10.
